mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_reviews (order_id, reviewer_id, target_id, score, attitude, content, temperature_delta, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{reviewerId}, #{targetId}, #{score}, #{attitude}, #{content}, #{temperatureDelta}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT temp FROM student WHERE unisno = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET temp = CASE WHEN temp + #{delta} < 0 THEN 0 WHEN temp + #{delta} > 990 THEN 990 ELSE temp + #{delta} END WHERE unisno = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT review_id, order_id, reviewer_id, target_id, score, attitude, content, temperature_delta, created_at FROM trade_reviews WHERE target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
